tip.general.1: Right-click the bar icon to start your default agent.
tip.general.2: Middle-click the bar icon to refresh usage right away.
tip.general.3: Give your pet a pat: click it.
tip.general.4: Open your pet's settings with the gear button above: shape, size, accessories and saved pets.
tip.general.5: One task per session: long conversations make every prompt cost more.
tip.general.6: Keep sessions focused so the prompt cache does more of the work.
tip.general.7: Ask for a plan before a big change. A plan is cheaper to fix than code.
tip.general.8: Paste the exact error message. Agents fix things faster with the real text.
tip.general.9: Use a fast model for quick questions and save the big one for hard problems.
tip.general.10: Point the agent at the files that matter instead of letting it search the whole repo.
tip.general.11: Review the diff before you commit, even when the agent sounds confident.
tip.general.12: Near a weekly limit? Spread the work across your other subscriptions.
tip.general.13: Write project conventions down once (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) instead of repeating them every session.
tip.general.14: Going in circles? Start a fresh session with a short summary of what you learned.
